links.outcome: Run-to-run complete agreement of numerical outputs across three repeated runs of identical prompts
links.effect: Complete agreement was 88.4% (deepseek), 98.4% (doubao), 98.6% (kimi). Deepseek was significantly less consistent (OR 0.086 and 0.072). Malignant inconsistency was 0.16% (3/1,920); most disagreement was rounding instability.
links.quote: Complete agreement rates were 88.4% for deepseek, 98.4% for doubao, and 98.6% for kimi.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the run-to-run consistency, accuracy, and cross-language agreement of multiple LLMs on synthetic cardiovascular risk communication scenarios without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
